headline: 阿曼达·麦克马斯特结束波士顿动力公司临时首席执行官任期
summary: 波士顿动力公司10月6日宣布普拉萨德于10月7日接任首席执行官，麦克马斯特的临时首席执行官任期随之结束；她继续担任公司首席财务官。

sources.title: Tech Moves: Microsoft CVP retires; former Amazon SVP to lead Boston Dynamics; Qualtrics, Overland AI, Fred Hutch name execs
sources.excerpt: He takes over from interim CEO Amanda McMaster, the company’s chief financial officer

sources.title: Boston Dynamics Appoints Rohit Prasad as Chief Executive Officer
sources.excerpt: appointment of Rohit Prasad as Chief Executive Officer (CEO), effective October 7, 2026.
